Whole Wheat Pastry
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 12:05am

Ingredients




1/2 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 cup whole wheat flour
1/2 teaspoon salt
 cup shortening
2 tablespoons cold water

Preparation

1 Blend flour and salt in a mixing bowl. Cut fat into dry ingredients until fat is cut into pieces the size of rice kernels. Sprinkle water evenly over dry ingredients tossing with a fork until all portions are evenly dampened. Press mixture into a ball. 2 Place ball of dough on lightly floured, cloth-covered board. Roll dough from center outward, keeping pastry as round as possible, about 1/8 inch thick. Arrange in 9-inch pie pan. 3 If pastry shell is to be pre-baked before filling, prick bottom and sides with fork tines. Bake at 450 degrees about 12 minutes or until lightly browned. One 9-inch pie shell.
